According to webometrics ranking of world universities, The top ranking universities of Quatar. 1881st worldwide. Texas A&M university at Quatar.

quatar culture is similar to other countries Eastern Arabia, being significantly influenced by Islam.

messages.message: Hi. I want to know more about the Maldives.
Would you like to know about the Demographics?
Yes, please.
The locals of Maldives speak English.
Do you have more information about that?
Yes I would be happy to share more information. The largest group of foreigners working in the country are 40,000 Bangladesh in the Maldives.
Do you know something about their economy?
Yes the country have six heritage coral mosques which are listed as UNESCO tentative sites.
Can you add more about the economy?
The tourism spiked and transformed the economy quickly. Then the economy wasn't only dependent on fisheries.
That was very informative. Thank you!
Also the economy was largely dependent on fisheries and trading local goods such as coir rope, ambergris and coco de mer before then.
Thank you.
You welcome!
Hello, can you tell me some information about South Dakota?
Sure! South Dakota is a state in the United States. South Dakota became a state in November 1889. Its capital is Pierre and largest city is Sioux Falls.
Could you tell me anything about their cities and towns?
Of course. Brookings and Vermillion are home to the state's two largest universities. Sioux Calls was the largest city according to a 2010 census with a population of 154,000.
Do you have more information about the cities and towns?

Rapid City is the second largest city in the state with a 2010 population of roughly 68,000 and a metropolitan area population of roughly 125,000. Also, of the ten largest cities in the state, only Rapid City is west of the Missouri River.
What can you tell me about education there?
South Dakota's largest university, South Dakota State University, is located in Brookings and has an enrollment of around 13,000 students.
Do you have more education information?

Yes! In 2007 South Dakota passed legislation mandating education about Native American tribal history, culture, and heritage in all schools from preschool to college in an effort to increase knowledge and appreciation about Native American culture as well as to enforce Native Americans understanding of their own cultures' contribution.
Very interesting, are there anymore interesting facts about South Dakota?
South Dakota is one of only 7 states in the US with one seat in the House of Representatives.
Thank you for the information. Have a great day!
You
Hello, I would like to know about the health in Paraguay please.
I'm sorry, I don't have that information at this time. Would you be interested in learning about its history?
Yes please. What information do you have on its history?
Paraguay's first dictator was Jose Gaspar Rodriguez de Francia who ruled Paraguay from 1814 until his death in 1840, with very little outside contact or influence.
Dictators shouldn't rule a country. Well, what happened after that?

He even cut off relations between Paraguay and the rest of South America. Following Francia's death in 1840 however, Paraguay was ruled by various military officers under a new junta, until Carlos Antonio Lopez (Allegedly Rodriguez the Francia's nephew) came to power in 1841.
Interesting.. Do you have more info on Rodriguez?
Unfortunately I don't have any more info on Rodriguez, but his nephew went on to sign a non-agression pact with Argentina and officially declared the Independence of Paraguay in 1842.
Seems everything stayed in the family! Do you have any facts about health now? or any other interesting fact I would like to know?

Sure! Did you know that the average life expectancy in Paraguay is rather high given its poverty? It was 75 years, equivalent to far wealthier Argentina, and the 8th highest in the Americas, according to the WHO (World Health Organization)
That is definitely good! Is there another interesting fact in your information?
The World Bank has helped the Paraguayan government reduce the country's maternal and infant mortality rate.
Thank you. I really appreciate this information.
My pleasure!
Hello , Can you tell me about Andhra Pradesh please?
Hi. Yes I can. It is a state in India, and it has one of the largest ports in its largest city Visakhapatnam in term of cargo handling.
What can you tell me about their Education?
It has a 67.4
It has 67.4 of what?
Sorry a slip of the fingers 67.4% literacy rate, which is high for India.
Oh wow that's good. What can you tell me about transportation there?
India in general has a good train system. Andhra Pradesh rail density of the state is 16.59 per 100 km compared to the Indian average of 20.
What can you tell me about their research efforts?

The state has 18 universities some which are involved in research. The universities are providing education on horticulture, law, medical, technology, and Vedic and veterinary. The Satish Dhawan Space center is located there and launches satellites and is operated by the India Space Research Organization.
What is the culture like there?
The Telugu film culture (know as Tollywood) is the 2nd largest film industry in India next to the Bollywood industry.
Wow thank you so much you have been very informative.
You are welcome. Goodnight
What can you tell me about the culture in Tibet

Hello, Tibet is a region that covers most of the Tibetan Plateau in modern-day China. It is the homeland of the Tibetan people and others such as, Monpa, Tamang, Qiang, sherpa, and Lhoba peoples. It is also now inhabited by a number of Han Chinese and Hui people. Tibet is the highest regiojn on earth. It has an elevation of 5000 m. The highest elevation is Mount Everest in Tibet, the earth's highest mountain, at a rising 8,848 m (29,029 ft) above sea level!
Do you have any additional information on Tibet culture?
Yes. Tibetan people, language, and culture, regardless of where they are from, are referred to as (Zang) although the geographical term Xizang is often limited to the Tibetan region.
Amazing! Is there any cool facts on the Zang people?
Well, I did find that the term Xizang was coined during the Qing dynasty, in the reign of Jiaquing emperor (1796-1820) through the addition of prefix meaning "west" of (Xi) tro Zang.
Could you tell me about different names in Tibet?

There are many! Other pre-modern Chinese names for Tibet include Wusiguo, historical linguists agree that Tibet names in European languages are loan words from Semitic or (') itself deriving from Turkic Tobad, literally: "The Heights" (Plural of Toban)
How did Tibet get its name?
I don't know Tibet got it's name but I do know that Tibet has been called the "Water Tower" of Asia. China is investing in water projects heavily in Tibet.
Thank you for this information. It was very helpful.
You're very welcome!
Can you tell me about Nova Scotia?
Of course! Nova Scotia is a small province on the east coast of Canada. The capital city is Halifax.
What is the demography?
I'm sorry, I do not have that information, but i do know that the Nova Scotia Sport Hall of Fame is where the achievements of Nova Scotian athletes are presented.
Can you tell me about the culture?
Cape Breton Miners' Museum and the Maritime Museum of the Atlantic tell the story of their working history.
What else can you tell me?
Nova Scotia has two national parks and many other protected areas.
Do you have anymore interesting facts?
Sure, the name Nova Scotia is Latin for "New Scotland".
You have been really helpful. Thank you.
You are welcome.
Hi. I would like to learn more about Fiji?
Would you like to learn a little information on the society?
Yes that would be great.
Did you know 96.4 % are Sunni Muslims.
No I did not. Could you tell me about the history of Fiji?
The Dutch and the British explored explored Fiji in the 17th and 18th centuries.
Sounds interesting. I would li8ke to learn more about the history.
Fijan culture have similarities to the Melanesian culture but have stronger ties to the Polynesian cultures.
Thanks. Could you tell me about the culture?
Did you know Family and community is very important to Fijian culture?
No I did not. This is all new to me.Thanks. What is the population in Fiji?
Around 844,330 which consist of Fijians, Melanesians and Indo-Fijians.
Thanks for the facts. Take care.
You welcome! Hope you have a good night!
Hi there, can you inform me on lesotho?
Lesotho is a small country in southern Africa. Its population is about 1,800,000. The capital of Lesotho is called Maseru.
What are some geography facts?
Lesotho is also the southernmost landlocked country in the world and is entirely surrounded by South Africa.
What else can you tell me about its geography?
Winters can be cold with the lowlands getting down to -7 "C and the highlands to -18 " Cat times.
Cool, hows their security?
Its chief officer is designated Director by the Constitution.
What else should I know?
What Questions you suppose to ask the assistant?
What else interesting should I know about Lesotho?
Lesotho holds one of the highest literacy rates in Africa, in part because Lesotho invests over 12 percent of its GDP in education.
Thank you for your help!
Thank you.
Hello. I would like to learn about the European Union. What can you tell me about the economy there?
The European Union, called EU for short, is a confederation in Europe consisting of 28 member countries. In terms of its economy, the EU is represented in the World Trade Organization.
Okay, great. Can you tell me about their foreign relations?
When it comes to foreign relations, the EU uses instruments like the European Neighbourhood Policy, which seeks to tie countries located to the south and east of the EU to the EU.
Cool. Is there anything else you can tell me about the economy or foreign relations?

For countries within its foreign relations European Neighbourhood Policy, the EU offers financial assistance. However, those countries who receive financial assistance must meet strict conditions of reform and transformation, especially with regards to their government and economy.
Interesting, thank you. Is there anything you can tell me about the EU's history?
During the 19th century, Pan-European political thought truly emerged. It was inspired by the liberal ideas of the French and American Revolutions after the demise of Napolean's Empire.
Okay. Is there anything else interesting you can tell me?
Some people criticize the EU emerging as a world superpower, pointing to a lack of a strong European military or unified EU foreign policy.
Okay. Thanks for all the great information!
You're welcome. Have a great day!
Hello Can you please help me find information on Namibia?
Okay! Namibia or The Republic of Namibia, is a country in Southern Africa.
Thank you I was unsure even where it was. Can you tell me information on the etymology of Namibia?
Before Namibia's Independence in 1990, it was known as German South West Africa, and then South West Africa. This reflected the colonial occupation of Namibia by Germans and the South Africans.
Wow that is interesting I have never heard of that happening before. Is there anything else you can tell me about the name Namibia?
Unfortunately My system isnt showing that information as available at this time; however, Namibia obtained full independence from South Africa in 1990.
Thats ok. I wouldn't believe there to be to much on the subject anyway. I know it sounds weird but I love to learn about media. What can you tell me about the media in Namibia?
Yes, I can provide you with this information. Did you know the privately held One Africa TV has competed with NBC since the 2000s.
Really wow that is crazy. I would have never guessed NBC had a competitor that I have never heard of. Is there anymore information on One Africa TV?
The Nambia public broadcaster offers a TV station and a Nation Radio"
Very cool. Thank you so much for the information today. You have been a great help.
Could I provide you with any other information on the Media of Namibia today?
Sure if there is something interesting you think I'd love to know.
Great! The print market of Namibia is complemented by party publications, student newspapers, and PR publications.
Wow lots of options for the people of Namibia. Thanks so much for all your information today!
I'm glad I could be of service!
Hello! Can you please tell me about culture in Chicago?
Happy to help you with that! The University of Chicago Cultural Policy Center ranked Chicago the third largest music industry in the US and fourth for number of concerts and performances in 2007.
Wow nice! Do they have a lot of museums?
I can tell you the Museum of Science and Industry is associated with the University of Chicago.
That's cool! Do they have some kind of space museum there?
Yes, the Adler Planetarium & Astronomy Museum is a great space museum! Also, the Field Museum of Natural History and the Shedd Aquarium are great too!
What can you tell me about infrastructure in Chicago?
Public transportation is overseen by the Chicago Transit Authority for the city and also some adjacent suburbs outside Chicago city limits.
Do they have many toll roads?
Sorry I don't have that information, but I can tell you in the early 20th century an attempt was made to link Chicago to New York via the Chicago - New York Electric Air Line Railroad.
Wow thats pretty cool! Thank you so much!
You're welcome! Chicago is a great city!
Good evening! Can you tell me anything about the history of Austria?
Sure! Austria is more than a thousand old. Its history can be followed to the ninth century.
Wow! I'd love to know more about it. Do you know who originally settled it or, more recently, which countries ruled it?
Until WWI, Austria's history was largely that of its ruling dynasty, the Habsburgs.
What happened after WWI?
I'm not sure. But I can tell you that the German speaking parts of Austria which had been part of Austria-Hungary were reduced to a rump state named The Republic of German-Austria.
Do you have any information about the origin of the name Austria?
The word "Austria" is a Latinisation of the German name and was first recorded in the 12th century.
Can you tell me what it meant in German?
The German name for Austria, Osterreich, derives from the Old High German Ostarrichi, which meant "eastern realm" and which first appeared in the "Ostarrichi document" of 996.
That is interesting. Thank you for teaching me some things about Austria tonight.
You're welcome!
Can you tell me about Kochi? What is the education like there?
Certainly. Most of the colleges in Kochi affiliate themselves either with Cochin University or with Mahatma Gandhi University. The state education board offers classes in Malayalam and English
Do most students learn English in primary school in Kochi?
That is correct, the only board that offers Malayalam instruction is the states education board. Everyone else offers English only
How is the Kochi government set up?

Im sorry, i dont have much information on how Kochi's government was set up, however it seemns their main focus was education, the government had 34 government schools, and 67 private schools as well.
Does Kochi have a governor?
It is actually govern by a few governors of Kochi Kingdom
What are some of the names of the governors?
I'm sorry with the limited information it doesnt give me any names of the governors
How long does a governor serve?
The governor has a 5 year term. What other information would you liek ?
Hi! What can you tell me about the culture of Cornwall?
Cornish wrestling is the oldest sport and native tradition of Cornwall. The sport has travelled the world.
I would never have guessed wrestling. Do you have any information about their food, languages or religions?
In literature Clara Vyvyan wrote various books on the many aspects of Cornish life, as in her book Our Cornwall.
Do you know if the books were written in English? I really don't know exactly where Cornwall is but thinking it's in or near England.
I not sure about that, but Rosamunde Pilcher grew up in Cornwall and several of her books take place there.
Can you tell me about the terrain there?
Yes! The geology of the Lizard peninsula is that of a section of oceanic crust now found on land. This is unusual on mainland Britain and is its only occurrence.
Is Cornwall an island?
No it is in the southwest of England on the Lizard peninsula at the southwestern point of Land's End.
Is its coast on the Atlantic Ocean?
Cornwall forms the tip of the south-west peninsula of the island of Great Britain along the Atlantic Ocean.
Thank you for all the great information!
Your Welcome!
Hi, can you tell me about Russia's geography please
Sure! Russia is also called the Russian Federation. It is a country in Eastern Europe and in North Asia. It is actually the largest country in the world based on the land area.
Oh so Russia is a part of two continents! Awesome. What else can you tell me about its geography?
Russia is larger than the continents of Oceania, Europe and Antarctica.
What about its climate? What is it like?
I do not have information about the climate yet. Would you like to learn about the economy?
Sure! That was my next question.
The Russian economy began to stagnate in late 2013 and in combination with the War in Donbass is in danger of entering stagflation, slow growth and high inflation.
What is Russia's main source of income?
The considerable potential of Russian forest is underutilized and Russia's share of global trade in forest products is less than four percent.
That's really underutilized for a country with a huge land area. What drives their economy?
I'm sorry, but I do not have that information at this time. However, Russia recorded a trade surplus of US $139.1 billion in 2017.
This is all I need. Thank you!
You are welcome.
Can you give me some information about Luxembourg?
I sure can! Luxembourg , which is officially the Grand Dutchy of Luxembourg, is a small landlocked country in western Europe.
You say it is landlocked, what is the geography of Luxembourg?
The Red Lands, in the far south and southwest, are Luxembourg's industrial heartland and home to many of Luxembourg's largest towns.
What are Luxembourg's territorial neighbors?

Sorry, I do not know that exact answer, however, I can tell you some more about their geography. The border between Luxembourg and Germany is formed by three rivers, the Moselle, the Sauer, and the Our. Little Switzerland, in the east of Luxembourg, has craggy terrain and thick forests. According to the 2012 Enviornmental Performance Index, Luxembourg is one of the world's best performers in enviornmental protection, ranking 4th out of 132 assessed countries Luxembourg also ranks 6th among the top ten most livable cities in the world by Mercer's.
What are the demographics of Luxembourg?

English is taught in compulsory schooling and much of the population of Luxembourg can speak English. Since the beginning of the Yugoslav wars, Luxembourg has seen many immigrants from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, and Serbia. Annually, over 10,000 new immigrants arrive in Luxembourg, mostly from the EU states, as wel l as Eastern Europe.
Are there any other demographic details you can provide?

According to data from the World Health Organization, healthcaqre spending on behalf of the government of Luxembourg topped 4.1 billion, amounting to about 8,182 for each citizen in the nation. Luxembourg's education system is trillingual, the first years of primary school are in Luxembourgish, before changing to German, while in secondary school, the language of instruction changes to French.
Thanks so much for your help!
You're so welcome!
Hi, what can you tell me about Morocco?
Hello! Kingdom of Morocco is a country in North Africa. Would you like to know about the politics?
Actually, yes, I would like to know about their politics.
Morocco has been given the status of major NON-Nato ally by the US government.
Interesting, do you know anything more about their political system?
In 2006, the government of Morocco suggested autonomous status for the region through the Moroccan Royal Advisory Council for Saharan Affairs (CORCAS).
Thank you for that information on politics. Is there anything that you can tell me about their education?
Morocco hosts the world's oldest university, the University of Quarouiyine.
Ok, that is good to know. Do you know about their schools for young children?
I'm sorry I don't know about that but I can tell you that for 2012 the World Bank forecasted a rate of 4% growth for Morocco. Would you like to know about the economy?
Ok, thank you anyway. Do you have an interesting fact about the economy?
Morocco has become a major player in African economic affairs and is the 5th African economy by GDP.
Great, thank you so much for all of the wonderful information.
You're welcome! Have a great day.
Hi I would like to learn more about Pakistan today.
Sure, I can help. Pakistan is a country located in southern Asia. Its called the Islamic Republic of Pakistan with a coastline along the Arabian Sea in the south.
Thank you. Can you tell me more about its geography or location?

Urdu speaking Muslims from India made their way to Pakistan in large numbers during the independence period, most were migrating to the port city of Karachi, which today is the largest metropolis in Pakistan.
Wow, that is pretty cool. Do you know how the climate or environment is in Pakistan?
I'm sorry I don't have that information right now, but I can tell you that Pakistan has the second largest Muslim community in the world, Indonesia is the first.
Interesting! Can you tell me more about the demographics in Pakistan?
The main region of Pakistan is called Sunni Islam
Awesome. Can you tell me anything else about Pakistan?
Yes, a lot of the birds that are seen in Pakistan are migratory and are usually coming from Europe, Central Asia and India
Very cool! Thank you for all your help!
you're welcome
Hello, I am interesting I learning about Bulgaria. Can you tell me where it is located?

Of course I can help with that. Bulgaria is a country in southeastern Europe. The capital and biggest city is Sofia. I also see that in 1946 Bulgaria became a one party socialist state and part of the Soviet led Eastern Bloc.
Thank you. Can you tell me about the economy?
Of course I would be happy to help with that. Bulgaria was know as a communist silicon valley during the Soviet era due to COMECON computing technology production.
Can you tell me what influences the economy?
The loss of COMECON markets in the 90s and the subsequent "shock therapy" of the planned system caused a steep decline in the industrial and agricultural production. the economy collapsed in 1997.
What can you tell me about the politics?

Of course I cant help you with that. I see that the first deployment of foreign troops on Bulgarian soil since WWII happened in 2001. The country hosted six KC-135 Stratotanker aircraft and 200 support people for the war in Afghanistan.
What information do you have about foreign relations?
Sorry I do not have access to that information. I do see that corruption has resulted in the rejection of the country's Schengen Area application and withdrawal of foreign investments.
Can you tell me more about the Schengen Area?
I dont have access to that information I do see that over 75 percent of the surface rivers meet European standards for good quality.
Thank you for all the great information!
You are very welcome. Have a great day!
Hello! What can you tell me about Equatorial Guinea?
Hi. The Equatorial Guinea is a nation in west central Africa and one of the smallest countries there.
Interesting, can you tell me any information on the politics of Equatorial Guinea?
The current president is Teodoro Obiang. Under Obiang the current infrastructure of Equatorial Guinea has improved.
That's cool, I didn't know that! Do you have anymore information on the politics in Equatorial Guinea?
I don't have more info on the politics there.
Okay can you give me information on the demographics of Equatorial Guinea?
In February 2012 the Foreign minister signed an agreement with the IILP on the promotion of Portuguese in the country.
Cool, do you have anymore demographic information?
In July 2012 the CPLP refused them full membership primarily because of its continued serious violations of human rights.
Oh that's so sad, hopefully they can change their views on basic human rights. Can you tell me a random fact about Equatorial Guinea?
Human rights watch and Amnesty international among other organizations have documented severe human rights abuses in prisons, including torture, beatings, unexplained deaths and illegal detentions.
Wow, I had no idea about all of the horrible things happening there. Thank you for all of the information.
You're welcome
I would like to know all about Germany please.
For starters German has a population of 80.6 million people, the largest in Europe (excluding Russia).
What facts do you have about the etymology?
Germany officially Federal Republic of Germany, the full name is sometimes shortened to the FRG or the BRD in German.
Any more on the etymology?
Sorry my resources are limited on that topic, but did you know Germany introduced the common European currency, the Euro in 2002.
What can you tell me about the economy of Germany?
Germany is the world's third largest exporter of goods, and has the largest national economy in Europe which is also the world's fourth largest by nominal GDP and the fifth one by PPP.
Anymore I should know about the economy?
Germany produces the second highest number of graduates in science and engineering after South Korea.
Thanks for the information and have a great night.
You're welcome. Enjoy the rest of your night!
Hello, Can you tell me an interesting fact about Arizona's history?

Sure! The Mexican Revolution was from 1910-1920. Several battles were fought in the Mexican towns that are just across the border from Arizona settlements. During the war, the U.S. Army occupied the national capital of Mexico City and pursued its claim to much of northern Mexico including what became Arizona Territory and later the state of Arizona.
Interesting! I thought it became a state before that. Do you have more information about it's history that you can share?

It became a state in 1912. What is now known as the state of Arizona was initially administered by the United States government as a part of the Territory of New Mexico until the southern part of that region seceded from the Union to form the Territory of Arizona.
Cool! Do you have any information on the recent history of Arizona?
Unfortunately, I do not have any recent historical facts about Arizona. What else would you like to know?
No problem. Do you have any information about its education system?

Yes. Public schools in Arizona are separated into about 220 local school districts which operate independently. They are governed in most cases by elected county school superintendents and overseen by the Arizona State Board of Education.
Good stuff. Can you tell me anything about Arizona's institutions of Higher learning?
There are three universities in Arizona. The University of Arizona, Arizona State University and Northern Arizona University.
Thanks. Do you have any information about the average education level of its adult population?

Unfortunately I do not have that information. The Arizona State Sun Devils and the Arizona Wildcats belong to the Pac-12 Conference and the Grand Canyon Antelopes compete in the Western Atheletic Conference. That's just a fun fact!
Thanks for all the great info. Goodbye!
My pleasure!
Hello. I would like some information on British Columbia.
British Columbia is the westernmost province in Canada. What else would you like to know?
What can you tell me about the transportation in British Columbia?
Travel from the rest of Canada before 1885 meant the difficulty of overland travel via the U.S., around Cape Horn or overseas from Asia.
Wow, that is interesting. Do you have any other facts about transportation?
The Rocky Mountains and the ranges west of them constituted a significant obstacle for travel until the completion of the transcontinental railway in 1885.
What can you tell me about the economy of British Columbia?

I'm sorry, I don't have any information on British Columbia's economy right now, but I can tell you that the longest highway is Highway 97, running 2081 km from the British Columbia-Washington border at Osoyoos north to Watson Lake, Yukon and which includes the British Columbia portion of the Alaska Highway.
British Columbia seems like a really cool place to visit.
Indeed. Can I answer any other questions?
That's all that I needed. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome.
Hello! I'd like to learn about Dominica
Hello! Dominica is an island nation in the Caribbean Sea, located between Guadeloupe and Martinique.
Can you tell me about the infrastructure or economy?
Absolutely! To fly to Dominica, you must travel through San Juan, Puerto Rico or other nearby islands in the Caribbean.
Cool, tell me more please

Many residents of the small Caribbean island were displaced by Hurricane Maria. As a result, the government pledged to build 5,000 hurricane-proof homes. The first 125 homes were ready for occupancy February 2019.
Thanks, what else can you tell me?
The Representative Government Association was formed after the war, due to an upsurge of political consciousness throughout the Caribbean.
That sounds interesting, do you know more about the political consciousness of the people?
I can tell you that the political power of the ethnic African population progressively eroded over the years.
In what way?

I don't have that information, but I can tell you that in 1838 Dominica became the first colony of the British West Indies to have an elected legislature that was controlled by an ethnic African majority.
Great info! Thank you so much for your time, have a good one!
My pleasure!
Can you tell me about Tunisia?
Tunisia is a country in North Africa.
Tell me about geography there
It is situated on the Mediterranean coast of Northwest Africa.
Interesting, do you have more facts about geography there?
The Sahel, which borders Tunisia is among the world's premier areas of olive cultivation.
Can you tell me about politics there?
It is subdivided into 24 governorates.
Your information was helpful!. Do you have more facts to share?
The anniversary of Ben Ali's succession is a national holiday.
Thank you for the information
Your welcome
Tell me about Saint Petersburg.

Saint Petersburg is the second largest city in Russia, with Moscow being the largest. It's located in northeastern Russia and is considered a major port, situated near the Gulf of FInland. Are there specific topics you'd like to delve into?
Yes, the geography please.

The Saint Petersburg Dam was constructed to prevent flooding in the area. Saint Petersburg is often called Russia's cultural capital. Saint Petersburg is also referred to the "Northern Capital", since several federals institutions have moved from Moscow to Saint Petersburg.
Wow, tell me more.

Happy to. Saint Petersburg is about 165 km from the border with Finland & is connected to that country by the M10 highway. Saint Petersburg, in addition to the monikers I mentioned earlier, is called Venice of the North because of its intricate web of canals.
What do you know about the cityscape?

The Winter Palace, faces Palace Square, which is the city's main square. The World Monuments Fund included the Saint Petersburg historic skyline on the watch list of the 100 most endangered sites in 2008. This was due to expected construction, which threatened to drastically change the city's skyline. Part of Saint Petersburg is designated a World Heritage Site.
Thanks any fun facts?

The Winter Palace is the former official residence of Russian emperors, also known as czars and sits near the Hermitage Museum complex, which stretches along the Palace Embankment.. The city includes several well known universities including Saint Petersburg Polytechnic University, Herzen University, Saint Petersburg State University of Economics and Finance and Satin Petersburg Military engineering-technical university.
Thanks for all your help today! I learned so much.
It's been a pleasure chatting with you. Have a wonderful evening!
Hello, can you tell me about Mozambique?
I would be glad to. Are you interested in its history?
Actually, yes that would be great!
In mozambique, sofala, angoche, and mozambique island were regional powers by the 15th century.
That's very early to have such power! Any other interesting facts?
in 1995, mozambique joined the commonwealth of nations, becoming, at the time, the only member nation that had never been part of the british empire
Okay, that's pretty interesting. Mozambique has been around for a long time! Can you tell me about the geography and climate now?

there are known to be 740 bird species in mozambique, including 20 globally threatened species & 2 introduced species, and over 200 mammal species endemic to mozambique, including the critically endangered selous' zebra, vincent's bush squirrel and 13 other endangered or vulnerable specie
Well, this is definitely a country to take care of. I am really enjoying these facts, do you have any more?
in 2019 mozambique suffered floods & destruction from the devastating cyclones idai and kenneth
Oh no! That is terrible! Thank you for the information, that should be enough for now.
you are very welcome

messages.message: Hi, I am in need of some information on Quebec. Can you help me with that?
Bonjour! The official language of Quebec is French! Quebec is a province in Eastern Canada. It is the largest of Canada's ten provinces by size.
Merci! Just the name Quebec sounds like a place where they speak French, eh. In fact, can you tell me about the Etymology and boundary changes there?

In 1870 Canada purchased Rupert Land from the Hudson Bay Company and over the next few decades the Parliament of Canada transferred to Quebec portions of this territory that would more than triple the size of the province
Wow! No wonder its the largest province. What can you tell me about National Symbols in Quebec?

Sorry I don't have any information about National Symbols, but I can tell you that The Province of Quebec was founded in the Royal Proclamation of 1763 after the Treaty of Paris formally transferred the French colony of Canada to Britain after the Seven Years War
That's still great information, thank you! Is there any other information about Quebec that you can tell me? Interesting tidbits and fun facts

The name Québec which comes from the Algonquin word kébec meaning "where the river narrows" originally referred to the area around Quebec City where the Saint Lawrence River narrows to a cliff-lined gap
Great! I'll be throwing that one out there on trivia night for sure. Thank you for all of the great information you've provided
you are welcome!
Have a wonderful evening
Bonne nuit!
Hello, I'd love to learn more about British Columbia
Hello, I'm happy to help! For starters British Columbia is the Canadian province farthest to the West. Victoria is it's capital although Vancouver is the largest city.
Very Nice, I would like to learn more about their History. Do you have more info about it?
Of course. British Columbia was the sixth province to join the Canadian Confederation in 1871.
Oh Good, any more exciting history details?
British Columbia has many First Nations groups that give the area a rich cultural and linguistic history.
Interesting! Can you tell me anything about British Columbia's Geography?
Not a problem! Before British Columbia was colonized by European settlers, it had the densest population of First Nations people in what is now Canada.
What is the main language spoken in British Columbia?
I'm sorry I don't have that information for you.
No problem, what else do you know about British Columbia?
The majority of the province isn't developed, so North American mammals that are rare in other parts are still plentiful in British Columbia. Any other questions I can help you with?
Superb! I got enough information about British Columbia from you. Thank you so much
My pleasure, have a great day!
I need to find info on Oman for a school project. Can you tell me some things about it?
Oman is a country in the southwestern part of Asia, it borders the United Arab Emirates to the northwest. Arabic is the official language!
That's a good start. What do their Demographics look like there?

There is a significant Sikh community in Oman, and Oman was the first Arab country in the Persian Gulf to have German taught as the second language. A significant number of residents also speak Urdu, due to the influx of Pakistani migrants during the late 1980s and 1990s
The German aspect is fascinating. I imagine Islam is the main religion?
Yes, but there are communities of ethnic Indian Hindus and Christians
Do you have any other interesting facts on Demographics for me?

Yes, Christian communities are centered in the major urban areas of Muscat, Sohar, and Salalah. Also, The Non-Muslim groups include: Jains, Buddhists, Zoroastrians, Sikhs, Jews, Hindus, and Christians.
Great info. I would love to learn about their Education if you can help me there.
Yeah! Oman's first university, Sultan Qaboos University, opened in 1986.
Do a lot of the children go on to get higher education?
I'm not sure, but I do know that since the 1970s the government has given high priority to education in order to develop a domestic work force; so I would assume yes.
Do you know if a lot of foreigners enter Oman to attend their colleges?
No I do not
You've been very helpful. Thanks.
No problem!
Hello. I would like to know about Kollam.
Certainly! Kollam is a city and municipal corporation in Kollam district in the Indian state of Kerala.
Thanks! What can you tell me about the major characteristics of Kollam?
Well, for starters it is one of the least populated cities in India. It is also a Hindu majority city in Kerala.
That is interesting. What else can you tell me about its characteristics?
It is the fourth largest city in Kerala and the fifth largest in terms of corporation area. Kollam continues to be a major business and commercial center in Southern Kerala.
Thanks! What can you tell me about the transportation there?
Kollam Airport at Asramam was the first aerodrome in Kerala.
Interesting. What else can you tell me in regards to transport?
State-owned Kerala State Road Transport Corporation (KSRTC) provides road transport and private transport bus operators.
Thank you for all the information. You have been very helpful and informative.
You're very welcome. Have a great day!
Hello. I like to know more about Florida.
Florida is a state in southeast United States and it is a peninsula because it is surrounded by water on 3 sides. The highest elevation is Britton Hill.
Any info on Florida's seaports?
To the east of Florida is the Atlantic Ocean, the south is Florida Straits, and the west is Gulf of Mexico.
Sounds cool. Any other facts about their Seaports?
The top countries for export are Brazil, Canada, Mexico, Germany, and Colombia. The imports are from China, Mexico, Canada, Germany, and France.
What is the economy like for Florida? I am sure it is great due to the theme parks!

As of 2018 it has the fourth largest economy of the United States at $1 trillion GDP. Yes, Walt Disney World Resort is the most visited vacationreaort in the world. It has over 50 million annual visitors plus there is Universal Studios, Busch Gardens, and Sea World theme parks.
I figured it would be that high. Any other economy facts?
Florida accounts for 5% of United States $20.9 trillion GDP. Florida also produces the majority of citrus fruit for the United States its a big oarr if the economy especially oranges.
Thanks for your information today!
You are welcome.
Hi, can you tell me about Jamaica?

Good Afternoon! I would love to, Did you know that Jamaica is an island country in the Caribbean and it is part of the Greater Antilles. The capital of Jamaica is Kingston and the island is divided into three countries and they are subdivided into 14 parishes. Jamaica is part of the West Indies.
Can you tell me about its geography?
Of Course! There are only two other Islands bigger in the entire Caribbean, Jamaica is the 3rd largest.
Sounds cool, what else can you tell me about its georgraphy?

A fun fact that is about the Geography and the Environment is that Jamaica has many fresh water fish that include livebearers, killifish, mountain mullet and the american eel; they spend the majority of their lives in Jamaica's fresh waters.
I bet they never get hungry there, what about its history?

Jamaica has many South Asian and Chinese descendants that still live there to this day, About 7,000 Americans have also come over to Jamaica as well as some of the Portuguese Jewish and Spanish who immigrated from England and the Netherlands.
I never knew Jamaica was that diverse. What else can you tell me about its history?

In 1655 it was the English who seized Jamaica and when they did many Spanish colonists freed their slaves and fled an d by 1660 Jamaica was a "New World" where many came to seek refuge especially Jews but also those who had left Portugal and Spain.
Is there a fun fact that you can tell me about Jamaica?

Sure! Here is some fun information about the Culture in Jamaica, they have a Jamaican Chess Federation or JCF also they have a Jamaican Basketball Federation JBF because of how popular these sports are in Jamaica, they are widely played in all of Jamaica.
Okay, thank you for all that information.
Your very Welcome!
Hello! I'd like to learn something about France please.
Hi! France hosts the annual Tour de France, the most famous bike race in the world, since 1903!
Okay! Do you have some history on France for me?
I sure do! France was struck by the Black Death, where half of the 17 million population died.
Ohh dear! Can you tell me some info on France
Sure! Particularly in Paris and the southwest of France, Rugby union is popular.
Cool! I'd like to know more about France's culture.
Okay, there is a professional competition for rugby league clubs in France called the Elite One Championship.
That's good! I was in France before, but do you know about their economy?
Oh that's awesome! France had tremendous influence over European politics, economy, and culture with it being the most populous country in Europe.
Cool! I wasn't there for long! Do you have any fun facts about France?
A little fun fact is that the Euro was introduced to France is just 2002! Can I help you with anything else?
Wow! That's not that long ago! I think that's it for now! Thanks and take care! Byebye!
Thank you, have a great day!
Hi! I am so excited to explore Barbados this winter but I would like to learn more, can you help me?
Barbados is an island country in the Caribbean Sea. Its capital and largest city is Bridgetown. The official language of Barbados is English. Would you like to know about the History of Barbados?
What about the population?
In 2008, the island had a population of about 284,000 people. About 80,000 live in or around Bridgetown. Would you like to know about the History?
Thank you for your enthusiasm to discuss the history of Barbados. What can you tell me?
During the Inquisition persecuted Jewish settled on Barbados. Would you like to hear more?
Yes, do you have more facts about their history?
Amerindian settlement of Barbados dates to about the 4th to 7th centuries AD , by a group known as the Saladoid-Barrancoi. Would you like to mow more about the history?
No, what can you tell me about their culture?

I have no knowledge of their culture, But I can say that like many other Caribbean islands, Barbados is famed for its white-sand beaches and turquoise waters. Would you like to know more about the Tourism?
No, can you tell me about transport in Barbados?
MY apologies, I have no knowledge of the Transport in Barbados, I can offer that Barbados maintains the third largest stock exchange in the Caribbean region.
Thank you for your help.
no problem!
Can you tell me about the economy in Lithuania?
Poles in Lithuania are the largest minority, concentrated in southeast Lithuania the vilnius region.
Awesome! What other similar facts can you tell me?
About its politic, the vote is open to all citizens of Lithuania, as well as citizens of the other EU countries that permanently reside in Lithuania, who are at least 18 years old on the election.
Any more political facts about Lithuania?
Lithuania is also active in developing cooperation among northern European counties. Lithuania has the highest number of prison inmates in the EU
I didn't know that! Can you tell me about Lithuania's economics?
I am sorry I don't have this information. is there anything else I can help you with?
Can you give me some facts about Lithuania?
Lithuania in 2018 became Associated member State of CERN. Agriculture in Lithuania dates to the Neolithic period about 3,000 to 1,000 BC.Since 29 March 2004, Lithuania has been part of the NATO
What else can you tell me?

Despite the fact that the guerrilla warfare did not achieve its goal of liberating Lithuania and that its resulted in more than 20,000 deaths, the armed resistance de factor demonstrated that Lithuania did not voluntarily join the USSR and its also legitimized the will of the people of Lithuania to be independent. As a member of the Commonwealth, Lithuania retained its institutions , including a separate army, currency, as statutory laws- the statute of the Lithuania.
Tell me more please!

In October 1939, Lithuania was forces to sign the Soviet-Lithuanian Mutual Assistance Treaty: five Soviet military bases with 20,000 troops were established in Lithuania in exchange for Vilnius, which the Soviets had captured from Poland. During the second half of 2013, Lithuania assumed the role of the presidency of the European Union.
Hello, can you tell me about Algeria
Algeria is a country located in the Maghreb region of North Africa. It is officially known as the People's Democratic Republic of Algeria.
Can you give me some information on its history
About 50,000 French people emigrated to Algeria between 1825 and 1847.
Do you know why that is

I am not certain why that is but according to the book written by Historian Been Kiernan on the French Conquest of Algeria, The French conquest of Algeria as completed by 1875. The actualisation of the conquest took some time and it resulted in considerable bloodshed.
Thank you, I would also like to find out about the country's health
Since 1882, health records have been maintained in Algeria. By 1905 during the French rule, the addition of Muslims living in the South to their Vital record database began.
Tell me more about their health records system

Unfortunately, that's all the information I have on health. But, let me tell you more about the history of Algeria. Algeria gained complete independence from french in 1962 when the war against the french rule was concluded. This was prior to the March 1962 Evian agreements and the July 1962 self-determination referendum.
Thank you, can you give me some fun facts on Algeria
Although French is not an official language in the country, Algeria is the second-largest Francophone country in the world in terms of speakers.
Thank you for the information
You are welcome
Hi. Can you tell me about the education system in Botswana?

Free state education was normal for two decades up until January 2006, when fees were reintroduced. However, any Botswana citizen who wants to attend the University of Botswana receives a full scholarship, including living expenses. Those who wish to pursue an education in a field that is not offered locally, citizens are eligible for a full scholarship to study abroad.
I never knew that! Any more information about their education system?
In Palapye in 2011, the nation's second international university was completed. That was the Botswana University of Science and Technology.
OK. Thank you. Can you tell me about the health system?
In 2009, life expectancy at birth was 55.The previous high was 64.1 in 1990 and the low was 49 in 2002.
Wow. I sure didn't know it was that low! Any more health information?

A good part of the reason for the swings in life expectancy is related to the AIDS pandemic. Botswana has been hit hard. An estimate claims that life expectancy took a large drop from 65 to 35 years in 2006.
That is sad. Any other information about Botswana?

Due to the ongoing pandemic, there are 21 priority countries identified by the UN AIDS group in 2011 and Botswana was one of them. The Global Plan was set up to reduce or eliminate new HIV infections among children, and also to keep their mothers alive.
OK. Any more facts?
That's all I have on Health, but on the topic of Economy, The Bank of Botswana is also a central Bank.
Great! Thank you for all your help!
You're quite welcome.
What can you tell me about Sussex?
Sussex is a county in East England. Among the areas are East Sussex, West Sussex, and Brighton and Hove.
Thank you. What can you tell me about the history of Sussex?
The Norman conquest for England at the Battle of Hastings was located in Sussex.
Okay, is there anything else you can tell me on this subject?
Harold fought the Normans at the Battle of Hastings from Yorkshire to where the army was defeated and Harold was killed.
What can you tell me about education in Sussex?
Some of the best independent schools in England are in Sussex. They are Christ's Hospital School, Brighton College, Eastbourne College, and Lancing College and Roedean School.
Oh great, can you tell me anything else about Sussex education?
The oldest school in Sussex is the Prebendal School in Chichester. It dates back to when the Normas moved the bishopric from Selsey to Chichester in the 11th century.
What is one more interesting thing you can tell me about Sussex?
The first medical school in Sussex was built in 2002. Its called the Brighton and Sussex Medical School.
Hi. I would like to learn about Pakistan.
Hello! Pakistan is a country in Southern Asia. It is next to India, Iran, Afghanistan, and China. It is officially called the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.
Thanks. What can you tell me about its Infrastructure?
Sorry! I don't have information about the infrastructure. Please let me know what other information you would like to know!
No problem. Do you have any facts about the government and politics of Pakistan?
yes, I do. Pakistan is an active member of the United Nations and has a Permanent Representative to represent Pakistan's positions in international politics.
Thanks. Are there any other facts about this topic?
Sure! Association football is the second most played sports in Pakistan and it is organized and regulated by the Pakistan Football Federation.
What is the culture in this country?
The Mughals introduced Persian literature and high culture, establishing the roots of Indo-Persian culture in the region.
Thanks. What is the climate like there?
Unfortunately! I don't have information about Climate. I can tell you about its Etymology. The word Pakistan meaning pure in Persian and Pashto.
No problem. Thank you for all the facts. Have a nice day.
You too have a Great Day!
Hello, I would like to learn about Burundi
Burundi is a small landlocked country in Africa. The capital is Bujumbura.
Can you tell me about its geography
Mt Heha, Burundi’s highest peak @ 8810 ft lies to the east of the capital. The country lies on a rolling plateau in the center of Africa
I have never worked with Mt Heha can you tell me more about it
I don’t have any more info on Mt Heha but I can tell you that Burundi is part of the Albertine Rift (the tropical broadleaf rain forest)
Thank you, tell me about Burundi demographics
The United States accepted 10,000 Burundian refugees in 2006
What happen that mad those people flee
Human Rights were being seriously violated. Also, Burundi has just one public university.
That is sad, what fun facts can you provide me
There are museums in the city such as the Geological Museum, the National Museum & the Museum of Life. Also, there are 2 National Parks & a small rainforest
Thank you for the information
You are very welcome
Hi, can you help me find information on the education in Islambad?
Absolutely! Islamabad, meaning Abode of Islam, is the Federal capital city of Pakistan. It is in the Pothohar Plateau located in the northwest of the country.
Great information, do you have any more information on the education and climate of Islamabad?

I do! I'll start with Education. Allama Iqbal Open University, located in Islamabad, is the world's second largest general university by enrollment. In fact, Islamabad boasts the highest literacy rate in Pakistan at 98% and has some of the most advanced educational institutes in the country. Let me know when you are ready to hear about the climate of Islamabad.
This is great information, yes I would like to hear about the climate as well.

Great! Islamabad has a humid subtropical climate ("Cwa" in the Koeppen climate classification). The city is rich in nature due to the micro-climates regulated by three artificial reservoirs. The Rawal, Simli, and Khanpur Dam.
Great information this is exactly what I needed.
Fantastic! Glad I have been able to help. Is there anything else I can help you with tonight?
No that is it, thank you.
Thank you! Have a great evening.
Tell me about the demographics of Povoa de Varzim.
Sure thing! If you are a native of Povoa de Varzim you would be called a Poveiro, which would be translated in English as Povoan.
Are there other ethnicities in Povoa de Varzim?

I'm sorry but I don't have that information available, however, I do know that 231 migrants moved to Povoa de Varzim from Brazil, the Ukraine and Venezuela, they also came from uzbekistan, Angola and Georgia, this movement occurred in 2017.
Can you tell me about geography of Povoa de Varzim?
I sure can! Povoa de Varzim is known as the region that is least subjected to frosts in all northern Portugal and it contains a microclimate.
Are there mountain ranges?

I apologize but I do not have that information available for you, however, I do know that the climate is considered warm-summer Mediterranean climate. It also has gentle summers and winters that are often mild and influenced by the Atlantic ocean.
Can you tell me which countries are its nearest neighbors?
Wow, you are stumping me tonight, I'm sorry but I don't have that information. I do know that on the west there is a shoreline on the Atlantic Ocean.
Can you tell me about it's history?.

Again, I'm sorry, I don't have information regarding the topic of history, however, China, other Asian countries, France and other European countries contributed to the majority of growth in foreign population.
THanks for all the information.
Sure thing!
Hello - can you give me some information about Svalbard?
Sure! Svalbard has Artic vegetation. There is also permafrost and tundra.
Wow sounds nothing like where I'm from. What else can you tell me about nature there?
Absolutely! Svalbard contains polar bears, reindeers and has 23 nature reserves.
Interesting - what else do you know about nature there?
In Russian settlements, there are limited domesticated animals.
Wow. Good to know. What about the geograpy? I could stand to learn more about that.
The island of Spitsbergen constitutes more than half of the archipelago with a land area of 61022 km2.
Sounds huge. What else can do you know about geography?
Svalbard has seven national parks. The names of a few are Indre Wijdefjorden, Nordre Isfjorden Land and Forlandet.
This has been very helpful, thank you so much for all of the information!
I am glad that I could assist.
Hello, I would like to learn about Tanzania.
Tanzania, officially known as the United Republic of Tanzania, is a country in East Africa that's part of the African Great Lakes Region. Three of Africa's great lakes are partially in Tanzania.
What could you tell me about the science and technology in the United Republic of Tanzania?

I don't currently have much information on the science & technology of the country, but I do have some cultural and demographic facts that may interest you. Tanzania is considered the most linguistically diverse country in East Africa, with over 100 different languages spoken there. There are a limited number of opportunities for formal European art training in Tanzania, so many aspiring Tanzanian artists leave the country to pursue their vocation.
Thats great! Tell me more about the culture of Tanzania.

Tanzania is considered a multi-cultural society with people from many different cultures, making it one of the most ethnically diverse countries in Africa. With all this diversity, you might find it interesting that most Tanzanian literature is written in either Swahili or English.
Is that is why it is called a Republic because it is a conglomeration of different cultures rather than just Tanzania?

Actually the name is a result of Mainland Tanzania, formerly Tanganyika, joining with Zanzibar in April 1964. Tanzania received its independence in December 1961. Zanzibar did not gain her independence until January 1964 through a revolution. Three months after gaining her independence the two countries formed the United Republic of Tanzania.
Wow that is so interesting. Could you tell me about the culture now?

I don't have any more in depth information on the culture of Tanzania outside of what we discussed earlier. I can tell you, according to the UN's Human Development Index from 2014, that Tanzania ranks 159 out of 187 countries in poverty. Interestingly,
No problem, thank you for all your help today!
It's been my pleasure chatting with you!
Can you tell me about Puerto Rico?

Sure! Puerto Rico, is a U.S. territory in the Caribbean Sea. This means that it is part of the United States and citizens of Puerto Rico are de facto citizens of the United States as well. Puerto Rico is not a country.
Is Puerto Rico in proximity with the US in terms of geography?
It is about 1,000 miles southeast of Miami, Florida.
Can you tell me more about its geography?
The Commonwealth of Puerto Rico includes the largest, main island and a number of smaller islands, including Mona, Vieques, and Culebra.
Who heads Puerto Rico's government since it's not a country but a territory of the US?
There is a Federal District Court for Puerto Rico.
How about the executive government if any?

I'm sorry I don't have any information on that. But I can tell you that Puerto Rico has its own National Guard, and its own state defense force, the Puerto Rico State Guard, which by law is under the authority of the Puerto Rico National Guard.
Thank you for this information. YOu've been helpful.
You're welcome
Good morning, can you tell me about Arkansas
Hello! Arkansas is nicknamed the "land of Opportunity" or "The Natural State"l Its Capital and larget city is Little Rock,
Can you tell me more about the population in Arkansas?
Of course. It has been estimated by the U>S Census Bureau in 2015 that around 2,978,204 people live in Arkansas.
Wow, that amazing! Can you tell me about the Cities and towns ?
Little Rock has been it's capital city since 1821 when it replaced Arkansas Post as the capital of the Territory of Arkansas.
Can you tell me about the Etymology and pronunciation
Algonquian people live there. This comes from an Algonquian term, Akansa, for the Quapaws, and is likely also the root term for Kansas.
I
I can tell you as of 2014 it was the most affordable U.S. state to live in.
Can you tell me more about Etymology and pronunciation
Citizens of the state of Kansas often pronounce the Arkansas River as or Kaenzes river, in a manner similar to the common pronunciation of the name of their state.
Is there any interesting facts about Arkansas that you like ?
1925 University of Central Arkansas established as Arkansas State Normal School was established.
Thank you so much for all of your help
You are very welcome.

related_entities: University of Arkansas School of Law

messages.message: Hello! What can you tell me about Kiribati?
Sure! It is a country in the Pacific Ocean.
Awesome! Can you tell me anything about the Politics in Kiribati?
Sure! They have no military and rely on Australia and New Zealand for defense.
Oh wow that is interesting! Can you tell me anything about the Culture of Kiribati?
In 2004, they started participating in the Summer Olympics.
That's really neat. Any other facts about the Culture of Kiribati?
The population is mostly Catholic and Protestant.
That is interesting. Any idea why that is?
I'm sorry, I don't know.
That's ok! Any other information on the Politics in Kiribati?
The main prison is in Betio. The Walter Betio Prison.
Interesting name for it. Thanks for all your help I think that about covers everything! Have a good one!
You're welcome!
Hi, I'd like to know about Pakistan?
Sure! Pakistan is a country in southern Asia. It is next to India, Iran, Afghanistan, and China. It is officially called the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.
Could you tell me more about Islam in Pakistan?

It is the only country to have been created in the name of Islam. It has been declared an Islamic Republic and Islam is the state religion. Pakistan has wished to create an Islamic Revolution in hopes that it was transcend borders covering Pakistan, Afghanistan, and Central Asia.
Interesting, do you have anymore information on Islam in Pakistan?
The arrival of Islam in Pakistan meant the very sudden end of Buddhist architecture in the area and a smooth transition to the predominantly pictureless Islamic architecture.
What language do they speak in Pakistan?

The Arabic language is officially recognized as their language bu the constitution of Pakistan but there are other languages spoken there, such as Punjabi, which is the most common language with 44.2% of the population speaking it.
What is the culture in Pakistan?
Pakistan has a rich culture with literature in Urdu, Sindhi, Punjabi, Persian, English, and many other languages.
Anymore information on the culture or customs in Pakistan?
The national poet of Pakistan, Muhammad Iqbal, has written poetry in both Urdu and Persian.
That's all thank you!
You're very welcome!

related_entities: Treaty establishing a Constitution for Europe

messages.message: Hi, can you tell me about Europe?
Europe is a continent. It is the western part of Eurasia.
Nice. What is its culture like?
Europe has become a relatively secular continent, with an increasing number and proportion of irreligious, atheist and agnostic people who make up 18.2% of Europe's population.
That is interesting. What else can you tell me about their culture?
The largest religion in Europe is Christianity, with 76.2% of Europeans considering themselves Christians including Catholic, Eastern Orthodox and various Protestant denominations.
Good to know. I would like to know about the list of states and territories within Europe?
The list of states and territories include Aland which is a region of Finland, two constituent countries of the Kingdom of Denmark, three Crown dependencies and two British Overseas Territories.
Are there any islands?
Areas with little more than a unique tax status such as Heligoland and the Canary Islands are not included.
Oh, so there are islands. Nice. What else can you tell me about the states and territories?
None of them are members of the UN.
Oh really?! Now that's news. Thanks for the info.
You're welcome
Hi, I know nothing about Kochi. What can you tell me about it?
Hello! Well By the 1870's, the capital of Kochi Kingdom was relocated again to Kotchi Suburb of Tripunithurg. Would you like to know anything else about the history?
Interesting. Yes, what other history facts do you know/
Okay so, The Royal family of Kochi relocated the capital of Kochi Kingdom to Thrissur, leaving nominal authority of Island of Kochi.
Wow is Kochi in India>
I dont have the exact location of Kochi
That's OK. What information do you have on education there?
Most of the schools owned by private organizations or individuals are affiliated to the Central Board of Secondary education (CBSE).
Ok interesting. I imagine there is a lot of tourism there. Do you have any information on tourism?
Unfortunately i don't have any information on tourism. There are government owned schools and government aided schools, which are affiliated to Kerala State Education Board.
What is their culture like?

Oh unfortunately, I don't have any more information on their culture. BUT There 34 government schools, 67 private aided schools and 31 unaided schools affiliated to the Kerala State Education Board in the city and suburbs.
Hum, no culture information. Oh well. Thank you I have all I need.
Okay great! thank you have a great night
Hi! I want to know about London and its administration please
Sure! London is the capital and the largest city in Europe. The City of London has its own police force, the City of London Police.
What else do you have on its administration?

Policing in Greater London, with the exception of the City of London, is provided by the Metropolitan Police Service, which is overseen by the Mayor through the Mayor's Office for Policing and Crime (MOPAC).
Is there any other important entity in London besides the Metropolitan Police Service?
The London Fire Brigade is the Fire and Rescue Service for Greater London.
Interesting. What can you tell me on its recreation?
Victoria Park in the East End and Battersea Park in the center are parks that are administered by London's borough Councils.
Do you know if the park is highly visited?

I do not have that information at this time. What I can share is that there are also a large number of parks outside the city center. These include; Hampstead Heath and the remaining Royal Parks of Greenwich Park and Bushy Park, Richmond Park, and Hampton Court Park. Hampton Court park contains a palace, and because of this, it is administered by the Historic Royal Palaces.
Interesting.. Do you have any other fact I may want to know about London?
Just that herds of red and fallow deer roam freely within much of Richmond and Bushy Park.
Thank you for providing me with all this information.
You are welcome!
Hello. I'd like to learn about Bratislava please!
Bratislava is the capital of Slovakia.
I see! Can you tell me about their education and science, please?
The first university there was Universitas Istropolitana.
Do you have any more information on its universities?
Other institutions of tertiary education are the public University of Economics and the first college in Slovakia.
Thanks. What can you tell me of its genealogical resources now?
The Zahorie and Danubian lowlands stretch into Bratislava.
Can you tell me more about the genealogical resources?
I am not sure about that, but I can tell you that various musical events take place at Bratislava Castle.
Sure, tell me about that.
Music flourished there in the 18th century and was closely linked to Viennese music.
Can you tell me more?
That is all the information I have about that.
That's okay, I have all the information I need. Thank you for your time!
Your welcome.
I like to know more about Thailand.
Good day. Thailand's slogan is "Amazing Thailand" which it uses to attracts tourist from around the world.
That sounds like a good slogan. What are thailand's demographics?
There are roughly 41,000 Britons who live in Thailand.

Salt Lake City also has the third-largest Sri Lankan community in the United States of America

It is a british overseas territory in the north atlantic ocean

The new infusion of west indians has both accelerated social & political change, and diversified bermuda's culture

Bermuda's national cricket team participated in the cricket world cup 2007 in the west indies

Yes! If you send mail to Guam, you don't have to pay extra postage since they're part of the US! It's considered domestic.
That's so cool! I'm gonna get myself a pen pal in Guam! Thanks so much for your help today. I learned a lot and all of it was very cool stuff!

It is a country in the southern part of Africa, its capital is harare

The university of Zimbabwe was built in 1952

An association of Doctors in Zimbabwe have made calls to the president to assist in the health services.

Many writers, artists, and musicians have hailed from Massachusetts and cultural activities could include a visit to the National Shrine of the Divine Mercy or a concert by the Boston Symphony Orchestra or the Boston Pops Orchestra.

Besides the fabulous Fourth of July fireworks concert with the Boston Pops, other fun cultural activities include the Boston Ballet, the Tanglewood Jazz Festival, and Boston's Freedom Trail is a popular trek.
That sounds so fun. How is the education there?

I agree, fireworks are fun! Massachusetts was the first state in North America to require the establishment of a grammar school or the appointment of a teacher with the passing of the Massachusetts Education Law of 1647. Now, over 300 years later, the University of Massachusetts's ( ( UMass ) flagship campus in Amherst has over 25,000 students.
Great! Do you happen to have any information about K-12 public schools?

Sorry I don't have any information about K-12 schools, but Massachusetts has some great secondary schools including, Massachusetts Institute of Technology ( MIT ), Williams College, Amherst College, Wellesley College, Boston College, and Boston University.
Thank you! Your information has been so helpful to me! I am so appreciative.

You're welcome! One more fun fact for education is... Massachusetts scored highest in math of all states and third-highest in reading on the National Assessment of Educational Progress. Have a great day!
Hi, can you tell me more about Papua New Guinea?
Papua New Guinea is an island country near Indonesia and Australia.

Sure! The Chinese have long beeb merchants in Papua New Guinea

It is a commonwealth realm with Elizabeth 11 Queen
What is the educational system like there?
I have no information on its education system but I can share an its history.

The nation established independence from Australia on September 16, 1975 becoming a Commonwealth realm continuing to share Elizabeth 11 as its head of state.

Not sure how its performing now but Chinese merchants became established in the islands before European exploration.

Take care

The Faroe Island better know as Foroya are a group of 18 Islands in the north Atlantic Ocean between Scotland, Norway and Iceland. They are part of the Kingdom of Denmark.

The 2011 census showed that approximately 48,600 inhabited with Faroe Island, and more that 43,000 were born on the Islands.

Since the Faroe Islands is a constituent country of the Danish Realm the education is influenced and has similarities with the Danish education system. They have an agreement on education cooperation between the Faroe Islands and Denmark

They have a deep Nordic Root. They aim to support and promote Scandinavian and Faroes locally and in the Nordic Regions

The Nordic House in the Faroes Islands is the most important cultural institution in the Faroes. The Nordic House is a cultural organization that is run by a committee of 8 of whom 3 are Faroes and 5 from other Nordic Countries.

On 12 December 1964 the Republic of Kenya was proclaimed , and Jomo Kenyatta became Kenya 's first president .

Kenya has good relations with the United Kingdom .

The United Kingdom ceded sovereignty over the Colony of Kenya .

The modern-day Kenya emerged from a protectorate established by the British Empire in 1895 and the subsequent Kenya Colony , which began in 1920 .

Kenya has a growing Christian gospel music scene .
what else can you tell me?
Throughout World War II , Kenya was an important source of manpower and agriculture for the United Kingdom .

Equatorial Guinea conceded their independence on October 12, 1968.

Oil was discovered there in 1955 by Mobil Oil Company.

Congress there constituted integration and the marriage of the Hispanic culture with African cultures.

Antarctic is the coldest of Earth's Continent. The Madrid Protocol bans all all mining in Antarctica designating Artatica, natural reserve devoted to peace and science
Interesting. What can you tell me about the biodiversity?
The flightless midge Belgica Antarctica, up to 6mm in size, is the largest purely terrestrial animal in Antarctica.
Wow, what else can you tell me about the biodiversity?

The Protocol on Environment Protection to the Antarctic Treaty (also known as the Environmental Protocol or Madrid Protocol) came into force in 1998, and is the main instrument concerned with conservation and management of biodiversity in Antarctica.
Interesting. What can you tell me about the population?

The first born in the southern polar region was Norwegian girl Solveig Gunbjorg Jacabsen, born in Grytviken on 8 October 1913, and her birth was registered by the resident British Magistrate of South Georgia.
I didn't know that. Can you tell me any other fun facts?
It contains the geographic South Pole and situated in the Antarctic of the Southern Hemisphere almost entirely south of the Antarctic Circle, and is surrounded by the Southern Ocean.
Can you tell me anything else about that?

The first semi-permanent inhabitants regions near Antarctica (areas situated south of the Antarctic Convergence) were British and American sealers who used to spend a year or more on South Georgia, from 1786 onward.
Hey, I need help learning about Alaska?
Alaska has an abundance of seafood with the primary fisheries in the Bering Sea and the North Pacific.

Yes, Alaska's main export product not including oil and natural gas is seafood, primarily salmon, cod Pollock and crab

Unfortunately I do not have that information, some more economic facts are that most farms are either the Matanuska Valley about 40 miles NE of Anchorage or on the Kenai Peninsula about 60 miles SW of Anchorage.

Common in Alaska is the willow ptarmigan its state fish is king salmon adopted in 1962. Its state flower is wild native forget me not adopted by the Territorial Legislature in 1917

The state motto is North to the Future, Nicknames "The Last Frontier or "Land of the Midnight Sun" or "Seward's Icebox", State bird: willow ptarmigan adopted by the Territorial Legislature in 1955.

It means that Turkmenistan does not participate in alliances and holds a position of neutrality.

In winter times, the air is mild and dry and it snows from January and May.

"Turkmen" means "almost Turk" to distinguish from the other Turkic dynasties in mythologies.

Now, the country has a policy that states that the universities in Turkmenistan should reject non-Turkmen surnames, as well as ethnic Russian ones too.

Well in 1444, Portuguese explores had named that landmark Cabo Verde, a few years before the discovered the islands.

Cape Verde became 153rd member of WTO in June of 2008

messages.message: Hi there. I am trying to source some information about the Soviet Union. Can you help me out with any interesting facts about its economy and history?
I sure can! The Soviet Union joined the League of Nations in September 1934.
I always forget about the League of Nations, that's for that information. Is there anything you'd like to ad, or rather, can you tell me more about some of the Soviet Union's history?

Oh yeah! The Great Patriotic War was started on June 22 1941 when Germany broke the treaty and invaded the Soviet Union. It has been debated as to whether or not the Soviet Union planned to invade Germany once it was strong enough, but regardless, German struck first!

I must confess history is not a topic I am that knowledgeable in, so I'm also interested in knowing more if you had anything specific to share, otherwise can you tell me about their economy or how history affected it?
I understand! That's what i'm here for! the first five-year plan for building a socialist economy was introduced by Stalin in 1928.
Ah yes, Mr. Joseph Stalin. I know some, but not a lot about him. Would you happen to have any other interesting facts regarding Stalin and his socialist economy?
Of course I do! In 1953 Stalin died and he was then succeeded by Nikita Khrushchev and in 1956 Khrushchev denounced Stalin and then began the de-Stalinization.
Hard to believe that wasn't that long ago. Very good information, thank you again. Any chance there's any additional information you could provide?
I am an assistant, I have tons of information! Before Joseph Stalin died, by 1940 he was able to announce that illiteracy had been eliminated. That is a pretty big announcement!
That's funny in ways I can't even begin to express. He must have known Al Gore who I heard invented the internet. Well assistant, I'm all ears if you have any additional information you can share.

That is quite funny, Al Gore was quite the guy! Well, Joseph Stalin seems to be a hot topic for us right now! by 1936 he had reversed the most liberal laws and he encouraged a pronatalist era, that ended up staying in effect for many decades to dome.

I wish I knew what the pronatalist era was, but Stalin definitely has made some history for himself and the Soviet Union that is for sure. That said, I'd like to thank you again for the information. At this time I'm all set and will be going. Have a great evening.
You are welcome! Good night!

Bangladesh is located in South Asia. Dhaka is the largest city as well as the capital. Muslim is the predominate religion there.

There is a lot of corruption there with bribes making up almost 4% of the national budget in 2015.

The sector with the most bribery at that time was land administration.

The etymology can be traced back to the early 20th century when the term was used in Bengali patriotic songs such as Namo Namo Namo Bangladesh Momo.
